stageClassificationSchema.meaning: Array of stage/work categories entailed by the exact original source row. Multiple categories mark separate work types or gates within one source item; they do not authorize parallel execution or imply completion.

categoryDefinitions.DEFINITION_WORK: PDP-0 through PDP-3 product-definition or source-current Discovery work.
categoryDefinitions.BUILD_IMPLEMENTATION: Build implementation or implementation verification work after the Discovery barrier.
categoryDefinitions.QUALIFICATION: Actual profile, artifact, provider, security, scientific, accessibility, performance, or other qualification work; a proposed experiment is not a result.
categoryDefinitions.INDEPENDENT_PRODUCT_APPROVAL: Independent product/consumer/owner approval or acceptance receipt from the authorized external authority; never inferred or agent-authored.
categoryDefinitions.PDP_CLOSURE: Native PDP closure/acceptance proof after applicable development completion; not the same as PDP DEV_COMPLETE.
categoryDefinitions.DELIVERY: Release, cutover, publication, handoff, or other Delivery-stage work under the applicable gate.

stageClassificationSchema.statusGuard: Classification is prospective work routing only. Preserve completionStatus as NOT_ASSERTED_BY_THIS_RECONCILIATION; it does not record execution, qualification, owner approval, closure, or delivery.
